'''Paraceratherium''' are [[extinct]] [[creature]]s from the [[wikipedia:Oligocene|Oligocene]] era. These rhino giraffe elephant-like creatures are well-suited for a [[meat industry]]. They are docile, passive and fecund. Their massive size means they will provide 700-1000 meat when butchered. If you trap a breeding pair, you will find that they tend to have triplets. They can have 1 or 2 litters annually. You can find this animal in the [[temperate]] [[forest]]. This animal will sometimes be used as a pack animal.
